answer: Splitting into 6 separate vaults needs a separate funded vertex account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the nadir binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The timber explorer reveals the whole merge tree. A 95 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
